sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/VibeVoice: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
sources.snippet: VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models. A core innovation of VibeVoice is its use of continuous speech tokenizers (Acoustic and Semantic) operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5 Hz. sources.snippet: VibeVoice ASR Streaming 1.5B is an open-source automatic speech recognition (ASR) model from Microsoft, available on Hugging Face. It is designed for streaming transcription and supports multiple languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, and Portuguese.
